the turn is finished (a capped round is told apart by hop.round_capped). Since collector@2.1.1 a THIRD sort travels here and it is told apart by `hop.degraded`, not by `round_capped` (which such a message does not carry): a turn that could not be assembled at all because the store refused a read or a write (GH #343). `hop.store_error` carries the store's `error_code`, `hop.store_operation` the op it refused, and the text names both. A parent that renders an answer must branch on `degraded` -- without it a failure reads as a real reply

A scan emits one such message per turn of the session that has not been written yet, so an occasion may carry several. On by default since the same ruling: it is the only path from a conversation into an episodes table

description.purpose: Scope marker of the collector hive: bundles the assembly state machine and its state surface. THE HIVE IS THE ADDRESS — everything from outside is sent to the hive itself, never to a cell inside it, and the hive hands it on. What an agent's LLM sees is decided in here, in one place, instead of spread over a persona cell, a prep cell and a tool-loop collector.
description.use_when: One per agent brain. Instantiate per agent tree and wire the parent's edges TO THE HIVE PATH (`./collector`), not to anything below it — see meclaw-overview § Die Hive-Grenze. `params.ports` is empty and therefore sealed: a mutation that reaches inside is rejected with hive_port_boundary.
description.not_in_scope: No inference, no persona, no tool fan-out, no durable memory. And no knowledge of its inside for anyone outside: which cell answers a lane is this hive's business and may change without touching a caller.
description.contract_in: Every message whose `hop.route` starts with `in_`. The eleven lanes in use: in_turn (a fresh turn), in_calls (the expectation set of a tool round), in_tool (one tool result -- every turn of its `messages[]`, never just the first, and never its `system` slot: GH #252), in_answer (the brain's answer), in_bundle (a memory bundle), in_advice (an advisor's answer), in_close (a closed session), in_prune, in_round_sweep, in_memory_call (the memory tool), in_thread_call (the thread tool). They are the same eleven the state machine dispatches on; a lane declared here that nothing behind the door reads would be a door into silence, which is why in_batch left in 2.0.1.
description.contract_out: Everything the assembler emits that is not an in_ lane and not the internal cstore write, leaving through the hive path: brain (the seam — the caller's edge carries the iteration bound and restore_ttl), recall, answer (THREE sorts: a real answer, a capped round told apart by hop.round_capped, and -- since collector@2.1.1 -- a turn the store would not let be assembled, told apart by hop.degraded, which carries no round_capped; a reply edge must guard on BOTH keys, GH #343), write, turn_write, prune. A caller wires the ones it needs and ignores the rest. `write` and `turn_write` are no longer two cadences of one document (GH #298, ruling Q11): `write` hands a CLOSED SESSION out as one batch with its `rounds` slot, for whoever archives a day, while `turn_write` hands out ONE TURN per message, addressed at a memory hive's episode lane -- and it does so per turn rather than at the close, which is why nothing said today waits for the night to become retrievable.
